deadline.value: International applicants should apply by June 1 for fall entry; domestic applicants by July 1.
deadline.quote: the deadlines for fall admission are July 1 for domestic applicants and June 1 for international applicants

gre_subject.value: The Ph.D. requires the GRE Physics subject test.
gre_subject.quote: For the Ph.D. program, the Physics subject test is required

gre_general.value: The program lists GRE scores as a requirement, not marked optional.
gre_general.quote: Two or more letters of recommendation from faculty (Optional) • GRE scores

supervisor.value: Admission is decided by the Physics Admissions Committee, not by a named supervisor.
supervisor.quote: The Physics Admissions Committee will review the applicant's documents on a preliminary basis

funding.value: Every incoming PhD student is offered a graduate teaching assistantship for the academic year.
funding.quote: All our incoming Ph.D. students are offered Graduate Teaching Assistantships for the academic year

also.quote: additional support of $6,500 is almost always available for the Summer

entry_route.value: A B.S. in physics or a closely related field is the entry requirement; no master's is listed.
entry_route.quote: Hold a B.S. degree, or equivalent, in Physics or a closely related field

notes: Department page gives no TOEFL score; the Graduate College program page prints 'TOEFL 4.5; IELTS 6.0; Duolingo 110' (conflicts with the 79 on the apply page; not resolved). Fellowships may be granted to incoming students. The department page says the Graduate College fee is paid online or by mail.
